MyContractIQ

01The problem, and who has it

Small business owners run on 10–50 contracts: lease, POS, software, insurance, suppliers, shipping, plus the client deals that bring in revenue.

They live in inboxes and memory. Renewal is the default: contracts roll over because nobody noticed the notice window.

  • Overpaying: two tools doing one job, uncompetitive auto-renewals
  • Penalties: a lapsed alarm contract went month-to-month at +$240 a year
  • Time: ~30 minutes to re-quote one contract, so it rarely happens
20.4%of small businesses fail in year one
49.4%fail within five years
$10,912/yr*overlap savings found in one test art shop's contracts (~6% of what it pays)

Failure rates: U.S. Chamber of Commerce. * Savings: MyContractIQ test run on 20 fictional contracts.

05Cost to run

$0.0002read one contract PDF
$0.071one rate check (3 runs with web search)
$0.002one portfolio review
~$0.29AI cost per business per month (typical)
BusinessesAI / monthRevenue / monthAI share
1$0.29$241.2%
100$29$2,4001.2%
10,000$2,900$240,0001.2%
~89% of a rate check is web-search fees, not tokens. So the savings come from running less often: only inside the 60-day window, cached 24 hours.

Cheaper search depth was tested and rejected: it searched more and invented a figure. Hard ceiling with caps: ~$21 per business per month.
